contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance computed for all 16 token pairs
contrast.finding_fixed: cement hairline measured 1.72:1 on white. Acceptable for decorative structure, not for the boundary of an interactive control. Added --line-control (muted, 11.37:1) and applied it to ghost pills, sorter options, and stepper dots.

reproducibility.method: two consecutive builds compared by SHA-256

answer_key_containment.note: assessment/key.json is never staged. The packager refuses to build if a file named key.json reaches the staging directory. Package contains 9 files: index.html, tokens.css, styles.css, scorm.js, app.js, content.js, module.json, imsmanifest.xml, and 2 SVG renders.

offline_behaviour.note: No external src or href in the shipped markup. Icons are inlined into content.js. Fonts use a local stack with system fallbacks. No network call at any point in the runtime.
